answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and the officer belongs to a specific faculty body.
The budget planning round is a central body where the officer does not take part.
Appointment matters are handled separately and the officer's place of decision is elsewhere.
The faculty council decides on the affairs of the officer's faculty.
Study commissions handle degree programmes which is outside the administrative officer's specific duties.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and takes part in examination matters.
Research funding is handled by researchers, not by the faculty administrative officer.
Module revision is handled by academic staff rather than the administrative officer.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the scope of the administrative officer.
Orientation week planning is not part of the administrative officer's designated tasks.
